name: Overcoming Stress
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming stress is rooted in trusting God's faithful presence and care, as He promises never to forsake His people (Joshua 1:5) and hears the cries of the righteous, delivering them from troubles (Psalms 34:17). Believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord, who sustains them and keeps them steady (Psalms 55:22), and to find rest in Christ when weary and heavy laden (Matthew 11:28). Even affliction serves a purpose for spiritual growth and understanding God's statutes (Psalms 119:71), leading the soul to bless and trust in the Lord’s holy name (Psalms 103:1).
